title: "summary reliabilities"
author: "andrew demetriou"

AIM: estimate reliability by value for primary study dataset

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library('here')                 # file logistics
library('dplyr')                # data manipulation
library('tidyr')                # data manipulation
library('tidyverse')            # code logistics
library('cowplot')
library('viridis')

values <- c("POWER", "ACHIEVEMENT", "HEDONISM",  
            "STIMULATION", "SELF", "UNIVERSALISM", 
            "BENEVOLENCE", "TRADITION",  
            "CONFORMITY", "SECURITY")
```


```{r}
# output file path
file_path <- here("_data", "_intermediary_data")

# read in data
wave_2_dfs <- readRDS(here("_data", "_participant_scores", "wave_2", "wave_2_dfs.RDS"))

# merge ethnicity
wave_2_dfs <- lapply(wave_2_dfs, function(df){
  df %>% 
    filter(item_ID != "attention") %>%
    mutate(Ethnicity = case_when(
      Ethnicity == "South East Asian" ~ "Asian",
      Ethnicity == "South Asian" ~ "Asian",
      Ethnicity == "East Asian" ~ "Asian",
      Ethnicity == "CONSENT_REVOKED" ~ NA, 
      .default = Ethnicity))
})

# rename variables
wave_2_dfs[1:2] <- lapply(wave_2_dfs[1:2], function(df){
  df %>% select(item_ID, participant_ID, Ethnicity, all_of(values))
})

wave_2_dfs[3:4] <- lapply(wave_2_dfs[3:4], function(df){
  df %>% rename(Spectrum = `Political spectrum (us)`) %>%
    select(item_ID, participant_ID, Ethnicity, Spectrum, all_of(values))
})

wave_2_dfs <- list(
  lyrics = bind_rows(wave_2_dfs[[1]], wave_2_dfs[[2]]), 
  speeches = bind_rows(wave_2_dfs[[3]], wave_2_dfs[[4]]) 
)
```


```{r}
# subsample by participant characteristics
ethnicity_subsample_lists <- lapply(wave_2_dfs, function(df){
  c(list(overall = df), split(df, df$Ethnicity))
})

spectrum_subsample_lists <- lapply(wave_2_dfs[2], function(df){
  c(list(overall = df), split(df, df$Spectrum))
})
```

```{r}
plot_precision <- function(df){
  
  # pivot to long format & estimate mean/sd per song/value
  df <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(values), names_to = "value", values_to = "rating") %>%
    group_by(item_ID, value) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(rating, na.rm=T), sd = sd(rating, na.rm=T))
  
  
  p1 <- df %>% ggplot(aes(mean, sd, color=value)) + 
    geom_point(alpha=.3) + 
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "magma") +
    theme_minimal() + 
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1,9), breaks = c(-1,0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p2 <- p1 + facet_wrap(~value, ncol = 2) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  plot_grid(p1, p2)
}
```

```{r}
lapply(wave_2_dfs, plot_precision)
```


```{r}
plot_na_percentage <- function(df){
  
  # long format
  df <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(values), names_to = "value", values_to = "rating") %>%
    group_by(item_ID, value)

  # compute percentage of NA responses per item
  percent_na_df <- df %>% 
    group_by(value, item_ID) %>% 
    mutate(is_na = is.na(rating)) %>% 
    count(is_na) %>% 
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n)*100) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # plot histograms
  my_colors = viridis(10, option= "magma")

  p1 <- percent_na_df %>%  
    ggplot(aes(x=percent, fill=is_na)) +
    geom_histogram(position="identity", alpha=.8, bins=25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(my_colors[5], my_colors[8]), labels=c("Present", "NA")) +
    theme_minimal()
    
  p2 <- p1 + facet_wrap(~value, ncol = 2) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  plot_grid(p1, p2)
}
```

```{r}
lapply(wave_2_dfs, plot_na_percentage)
```
